note: The demangler state cursor is initialized to the caller supplied mangled input buffer.
Parsing the leading _Z token advances the cursor to the terminating NUL of the two byte input.
After the _Z prefix, name parsing tries the St unscoped-name alternative with the cursor still at the input terminator.
The two-character token parser does not first require two remaining characters before evaluating the second character of state->mangled_cur.
With state->mangled_cur pointing at Buffer[Size], reading index 1 accesses one byte past the fuzzer stack buffer including its terminator.
